thread:
Alex: Quick handoff — I'm wrapping up the midnight rotation. Ongoing: spike in upstream KV evictions causing occasional 503s on embeddings route. Primary swap to eu-west secondary happened 30m ago to relieve pressure. Mitigations in flight and what to watch below.

Alex: Pager summary from pagerbot: `KV eviction rate ↑ 4x`, `embeddings-prod` p99 latency 3.2s, some 500/503 errors from model-router. Customer-facing impact: intermittent embedding failures (retry-friendly), small subset of high-throughput customers saw ~1–2% error rate over the last hour.

pagerbot: SYSTEM: Alert: KV_NODE_EVICTION_RATE_HIGH (started 8367889800). Affected: kv-cluster-eu-west-2. Current: eviction_rate=481/min, threshold=120/min.

Mira: Thanks Alex. I'm taking primary for the next 4h. Can you confirm whether the warmfix you applied is still active and the rollout id? I saw a partial kernel tweak rolled out earlier.

Alex: Warmfix is active on the routing layer (reduces aggressive cache TTL invalidation). Rollout id: r-2026-03-warmfix-17. Deployed to eu-west primary nodes only. Command we ran:

```
./opsctl rollout apply r-2026-03-warmfix-17 --service model-router --region eu-west --force
```

Alex: Also enabled temporary prefetching backoff config to reduce churn: `router.config.prefetch.enabled=false` for affected pool.

Jon: Noted. I pushed an extra eviction metric to dashboards so you can watch kv.evictions.per_min. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/board/kvevictions (bookmark). p99 tail for embeddings-shard-3 is the worst.

Sam: Are we currently routing traffic to standby replicas? I saw mention of a primary->secondary swap, want to confirm fallback policy.

Alex: Yes — traffic was swapped to secondary pool in eu-west (auto-swap policy triggered due to mempressure). Fallback policy remains: if secondary lag > 5s then drain to global read-only routing which returns 429s for embeddings. We haven't hit that yet.

Linh: I'm watching customer queues. I've escalated to solutions for the three impacted customers (internal ticket IDs: INT-8721, INT-8723, INT-8729). They received retries automatically. No escalations to account teams so far.

Mira: Actions on my side:
- keep warmfix active and extend to secondary pool if metric stabilizes
- run targeted `kv compact` on shard-3 to reduce eviction pressure (after consensus)
- open canary route to a small set of low-risk customers to validate latency improvements

Mira: If compaction looks safe, do it during low-traffic window in ~20–30m.

Alex: I agree. Pre-checks I ran: disk utilization ok, but mem fragmentation on several nodes is high. Compact should be safe but will increase IO for a short period.

Jon: Command for compaction (run only on the shard owner nodes):
```
ssh ops@kv-shard-3-0
sudo /usr/local/bin/kv-compact --shard=3 --throttle=0.2
```
I'll stand by to watch the IO metrics.

pagerbot: NOTE: Deployment r-2026-03-warmfix-17 rolled to 4/6 nodes in eu-west at 8367889900. Remaining 2 nodes pending. No errors reported.

Sam: Two quick asks: 1) Can we add a temporary alert to lower threshold for eviction_rate for eu-west to catch regressions sooner? 2) Any risk to embeddings-archive backups during compaction?

Alex: 1) Yes, I can create a transient alert rule with threshold 200/min for next 6h. 2) Backups are queued and will proceed but compaction will not touch backup process; still, schedule compaction to avoid backup window in 15m.

Mira: I'll coordinate the timing — aim for compaction at 00:20 UTC. If eviction rate doesn't drop below 200/min by then, proceed. Notify in this thread and add `--throttle=0.1` if eviction_rate > 300/min to reduce IO impact.

Linh: Customer comms plan: send proactive note to affected customers if we keep >1% error rate for another hour. For now monitoring only.

Alex: Running transient alert now.

Alex: `opsctl alert create --name kv-eviction-eu-west-temp --expr "evictions_per_min > 200" --duration 6h`

pagerbot: ALERT CREATED: kv-eviction-eu-west-temp (threshold=200/min) by Alex at 8367890001.

Jon: Observability note: watch `router.kv_cache_hit_ratio`, `evictions_per_min`, `embeddings.request_errors_5xx` and `model-router.queue_depth` during compaction. I'll keep the Grafana watch open.

Mira: If compaction helps, we should roll warmfix to the remaining nodes after compaction finishes and validate p99 downtrend before handoff.

Sam: Do we want to prepare a quick rollback plan if compaction causes instability? What's the circuit breaker?

Alex: Rollback compaction: stop the compaction process on target node: `pkill -f kv-compact`; notify Jon to rollback warmfix if any load anomalies show. Circuit breaker for routing: if `embeddings.request_errors_5xx` > 5% for 5m, switch traffic to global read-only for embeddings and page infra-ops.

Mira: Copy. I'll run canary to 2 customers after compaction and post results here.

Linh: Noticed a small spike in 429s just now (00:02 UTC) as some requests hit read-only fallback briefly. Rate about 0.6% total — included in monitoring.

Alex: I'm going to finish log aggregation and handoff docs. Key runbook refs:
- Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/kv-eviction
- Routing fallback: https://wiki.redwood/playbooks/router-fallback
- Rollout rollback: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/rollouts

Alex: Leaving the following checklist for Mira (primary):
- confirm compaction start at 00:20 UTC
- throttle to 0.1 if eviction_rate > 300/min
- roll warmfix to remaining eu-west nodes post-compaction
- monitor customer-errors and open public comms if >1% for >60m
- escalate to infra pager if embeddings errors >5% sustained

Mira: Acknowledged. I'll post start/finish messages and ping infra if anything odd. Thanks Alex, enjoy the rest of your night.

Alex: Thanks — passing primary to Mira. Secondary: Jon (standby). Contact Sam for customer comms, Linh for account-level followups.

deploy-bot: INFO: Canary route created: canary/embeddings-lowrisk -> 2 customers at 8367890320.

Mira: Starting compaction now on shard-3 (throttle=0.1). Monitoring IO and eviction rate. Will report back in ~10m.

Jon: Watching IO, eviction rate trending down to 220/min and embeddings p99 from 3.2s -> 1.6s (first signs good). I'll keep an eye.

Linh: Customer queues looking stable for now; no new retries reported.

Mira: Compaction finished on shard-3 at 8367890387. Eviction rate down to 140/min, embeddings p99 ~1.1s. Canary route healthy. I'm keeping warmfix on and starting rollout to remaining nodes.

Alex: Excellent. I'll mark handoff complete in rotation doc. Mira — you're primary, Jon standby. Good luck.

Mira: Thanks — taking over. If anything, re-page infra->pager duty. :thumbsup:
